name: Home First Finance Company India Ltd
about: Home First Finance Company India (HFFC) is a Housing Finance Company which offers home loan with 48 hours sanctions and hassle-free process. [1]
key_points: Offerings [1] The company is a technology-driven affordable housing finance company with a pan-India presence, focused on first-time homebuyers from families earning below Rs. 50,000 per month. Housing loans account for 83% of AUM with an average ticket size of ~Rs. 12 lakh. The company has a diversified lender base of 31 banks/FIs, positive ALM, no commercial paper exposure, and utilizes data-driven underwriting and proprietary credit scoring models. Its distribution network covers ~ 80% of India's affordable housing market.

profile.summary: Home First Finance Company India Limited operates as a housing finance company in India. The company offers home, self-construction, renovation, mortgage, shop, and resale, as well as top-up loans. It also provides insurance loan products and loans through mobile applications. The company serves salaried professionals, self-employed individuals, informal earners, and small business owners, as well as corporates. Home First Finance Company India Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
